summary: Targeted frontend theme verification completed. Tenant purple loaded correctly; orange utility buttons and sidebar matched it; red updated live and persisted after reload; emerald persisted across logout/login; hover/soft shades were correct; super admin remained default orange; and the tenant was restored to #7C3AED. Requested regression pages loaded and PUT /api/tenant/me succeeded with the required full payload. One accessibility issue and recurring dashboard chart warnings remain.

ui_bugs.issue: Dashboard still emits repeated Recharts ResponsiveContainer width(-1)/height(-1) warnings during initial rendering; charts later render.

design_issues.screen: Super Admin / default orange action buttons
issues: The computed #FAFAFA text on #F97316 background has only 2.69:1 contrast at 14px, below WCAG AA 4.5:1. Use a darker brand shade or dynamically choose a dark foreground for light primary colors.

action_items: Add contrast-aware foreground selection for tenant/default primary colors; the default orange button currently fails WCAG AA.
Resolve the existing Recharts initial negative-size warnings.
Add data-testid attributes to the Settings theme tab and Temayı Uygula button for stable regression automation.
critical_code_review_comments: The global !important overrides repair the reported hardcoded-orange behavior, but they remain coupled to Tailwind class names. Prefer semantic brand utility classes or Tailwind colors backed directly by CSS variables to prevent future orange utilities from bypassing the theme.
Theme foreground color is fixed to white and is not derived from primary-color luminance; arbitrary or light brand colors can produce inaccessible buttons.
Settings theme controls lack data-testid attributes even though they are critical interactive controls.

success_rate.backend: Not requested (frontend-only review); PUT /api/tenant/me integration returned 200 with full required payload
success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested functional theme and regression checks passed; one low-priority runtime warning and one accessibility design issue observed

seed_data_creation: No records created. Temporarily changed the demo tenant theme to red and emerald, then restored and re-saved purple #7C3AED.
test_credentials: Used both accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md successfully. /app/auth_testing.md was absent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo tenant is restored to #7C3AED. Verified computed tenant values: primary #7C3AED, hover #6d33d1, soft #ebe1fc, strong #592aab. Super admin computes #F97316. Initial unauthenticated /api/auth/me 401 is expected on the login page.
rca_of_the_issue: The reported theme bug is fixed: global CSS now maps the existing orange utility classes to AuthContext CSS variables, and refresh() reapplies saved tenant data immediately. Remaining contrast risk is caused by retaining a fixed near-white text color regardless of primary-color luminance.
